Finding care, screen by screen.

One-time and recurring care from creation to closed. Explore every captured tab and expanded panel, compare desktop with mobile, and open the complete inventory after the local redesign implementation.

Master tracking fileCapture manifestMethod and coverageVerified UI observationsLocal app & role credentialsRole login checks & screenshotsImplementation guideInformation preservation mapFinal capture validation & refresh proof
Post-implementation local UI verification. These are actual current-application screenshots with synthetic data, captured in Edge Chromium after the Vite build. Desktop 1440 × 1000; mobile 390 × 844 with touch emulation; DPR 1. Remote map/payment widgets were blocked in this local session; Brand fonts are served locally. Widget fallback states are preserved. Source inventories list conditional branches beyond the pictured states.
